request.style: English, male baritone voice with smooth jazz phrasing, upright bass, brushed drums, muted trumpet, piano, brushed cymbals, mysterious and dramatic mood, 72 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
They traveled through the island to Paphos
Found a Jewish magician and false prophet
Named Bar-Jesus with the proconsul
Sergius Paulus an intelligent man
The proconsul sent for Barnabas and Saul
Eager to hear the word of God

[Chorus]
You are full of every kind of deceit
You son of the devil and fraud
Enemy of all that is right
Twisting the straight paths of the Lord

[Verse]
But Elymas the magician opposed them
Trying to turn the proconsul away
From the faith he sought to find
Saul looked straight at him with power
Filled with the Holy Spirit in that moment

[Chorus]
You are full of every kind of deceit
You son of the devil and fraud
Enemy of all that is right
Twisting the straight paths of the Lord

[Bridge]
The hand of the Lord is against you
You will be blind and unable to see
A mist and darkness came over him
He groped about seeking a hand to lead

[Outro]
When the proconsul saw what had happened
He believed astounded at the teaching
